spell, agent, shift, rotate, shrink, paint, rainbow-arc, context-tint, grid-stamp, pattern, sustain (from change)
- oscillation: drive (forces), oscillate (waves)
- E_entropy: scatter (random), flow (noise)
- λ_edge: evolve (CA), split (fractals), grow (lsystems), seed (procgen), flock (swarm)
- integration: flex (softbody), learn (ML)
- relation (graphtheory hinge): connect

At synthesis, **no new affordance**. Instead, the bracelet **gains a synthesis mode** where the player can combine ANY two affordances. The catalyst now does composition — the player builds their own gesture vocabulary.
